assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Follow the documented procedure and listen for the information under test.

title: Client-side route change leaves the page title unchanged
description: Following a link inside the records browser swaps the view without changing document.title. The visible heading changes to About the records, but the tab, history entry and screen-reader page context still say Observation records: latest and about.

relatedElements.note: The control updates the title on each route change.

expectedBehaviour: A client-side route change updates the page title to describe the new view.
actualBehaviour: document.title remains the initial page title after the view changes.
userImpact: Screen-reader and tab users cannot tell which view is showing, and the history entry is misleading.

wcag.note: The page title does not describe the current view.

detection.note: Requires a route change; a single-page scan sees a correct title.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported; the control on the same page also passes.

manualTests: Follow a link in the records browser and listen for the page title or check the tab.

assertions: document.title is unchanged after the About view is rendered.
tests: tests/responsive-and-state.spec.js: keeps the alpha page title and announcement stale

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
